H2400.def: a criminal, or one accounted guilty

H2401.def: an offence, or a sacrifice forit

H2402.def: an offence, and the penalty or sacrifice forit

H2403.def: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
H2403.kjv: punishment (of sin), purifying(-fication for sin), sin(-ner, offering).

H2405.def: properly, a carving; hence, a tapestry (as figured)

H2406.def: wheat, whether the grain or the plant

H2407.derivation: from an unused root of uncertain signification;
H2407.def: Chattush, the name of four or five Israelites

H2408.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2398 (חָטָא);

H2410.derivation: from an unused root apparently meaning to dig out; explorer;

H2411.derivation: from an unused root apparently meaning to wave; fluctuating;

H2414.def: to clutch; hence, to seize as aprisoner

H2415.derivation: from an unused root of uncertain signification;

H2416.def: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H2416.kjv: [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.

H2417.def: alive; also (as noun in plural) life

H2419.derivation: from H2416 (חַי) and H410 (אֵל); living of God;

H2420.def: a puzzle, hence, a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim
H2420.kjv: dark saying (sentence, speech), hard question, proverb, riddle.

H2421.def: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H2421.kjv: keep (leave, make) alive, [idiom] certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, ([idiom] God) save (alive, life, lives), [idiom] surely, be whole.

H2426.derivation: or (shortened) חֵל; a collateral form of H2428 (חַיִל);
H2426.def: an army; also (by analogy,) an intrenchment
H2426.kjv: army, bulwark, host, [phrase] poor, rampart, trench, wall.

H2428.def: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H2428.kjv: able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).

H2431.derivation: or חֵלָאםxlit Chêlʼâm corrected to Chêlâʼm; from H2428 (חַיִל); fortress;
H2431.def: Chelam, a place East of Palestine

H2435.def: properly, the (outer) wall side; hence, exterior; figuratively, secular (as opposed to sacred)

H2436.derivation: or חֵק; and חוֹק; from an unused root, apparently meaning to inclose;

H2437.derivation: from H2357 (חָוַר) in the sense of splendor;

H2438.derivation: or חִירוֹםlemma חִירֹם missing vav, corrected to חִירוֹם; another form of H2361 (חוּרָם);
H2438.def: Chiram or Chirom, the name of two Tyrians

H2441.derivation: probably from H2596 (חָנַךְ) in the sense of tasting;
H2441.def: properly, the palate or inside of the mouth; hence, the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing)

H2442.derivation: a primitive root (apparently akin to H2707 (חָקָה) through the idea of piercing);
H2442.def: properly, to adhere to; hence, to await

H2444.derivation: from the same as H2447 (חַכְלִיל); dark;

H2445.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2449 (חָכַם);

H2446.derivation: from the base of H2447 (חַכְלִיל) and H3050 (יָהּ); darkness of Jah;

H2447.derivation: by reduplication from an unused root apparently meaning to be dark;
H2447.def: darkly flashing (only of the eyes); in a good sense, brilliant (as stimulated by wine)

H2448.def: flash (of the eyes); in a bad sense, blearedness

H2449.def: to be wise (in mind, word or act)
H2449.kjv: [idiom] exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make wiser.

H2454.derivation: or חַכְמוֹת; collateral forms of H2451 (חׇכְמָה);

H2459.derivation: or חֵלֶב; from an unused root meaning to be fat;
H2459.def: fat, whether literally or figuratively; hence, the richest or choice part

H2464.def: galbanam, an odorous gum (as if fatty)

H2465.derivation: from an unused root apparently meaning to glide swiftly;
H2465.def: life (as a fleeting portion of time); hence, the world (as transient)

H2469.def: Cheldai, the name of two Israelites

H2470.derivation: a primitive root (compare H2342 (חוּל), H2470 (חָלָה), H2490 (חָלַל));
H2470.def: properly, to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat
H2470.kjv: beseech, (be) diseased, (put to) grief, be grieved, (be) grievous, infirmity, intreat, lay to, put to pain, [idiom] pray, make prayer, be (fall, make) sick, sore, be sorry, make suit ([idiom] supplication), woman in travail, be (become) weak, be wounded.

H2473.derivation: or (shortened) חֹלֹן; probably from H2344 (חוֹל); sandy;
H2473.def: Cholon, the name of two places in Palestine

H2479.derivation: feminine from the same as H2478 (חַלְחוּל);

H2486.derivation: or חָלִלָה; a directive from H2490 (חָלַל);
H2486.def: literal fora profaned thing; used (interj.) far be it!

H2489.derivation: or חֵלְכָה; apparently from an unused root probably meaning to be dark or (figuratively) unhappy;

H2490.derivation: a primitive root (compare H2470 (חָלָה)); also denominative (from H2485 (חָלִיל))
H2490.def: properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute)
H2490.kjv: begin ([idiom] men began), defile, [idiom] break, defile, [idiom] eat (as common things), [idiom] first, [idiom] gather the grape thereof, [idiom] take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.

H2492.def: properly, to bind firmly, i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream
H2492.kjv: (cause to) dream(-er), be in good liking, recover.

H2493.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2492 (חָלַם);

H2495.derivation: from H2492 (חָלַם) (in the sense of insipidity);

H2496.derivation: probably from H2492 (חָלַם) (in the sense of hardness);

H2498.def: properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change
H2498.kjv: abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.
